subject: Finalizing guest slots + 2-line intro blurbs for May webinar
body:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Ahmed <sana@acmeanalytics.com>, Jorge Morales <jorge@edgeai.co>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, Apr 28 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finalizing guest slots + 2-line intro blurbs for May webinar

Hi Sana, hi Jorge —

Thanks again for agreeing to join us on May 12 for the "Serving LLMs at Scale" webinar. Two quick asks so we can finish the speaker page and calendar invites: 

1) Can each of you send a 1–2 sentence intro blurb we can read when introducing you? (Very short; ~20–30 words)
2) Any hard constraints on your slot (morning/evening in PT) — we have two guest slots: 10:05–10:20 PT and 10:40–10:55 PT.

Attaching the latest speaker brief and the slide template. We will host a 30-minute run-through on May 10 (30 min) for all panelists; Dylan will share the calendar invite once slots are confirmed.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference
---
From: Sana Ahmed <sana@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Apr 29 2027 07:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Finalizing guest slots + 2-line intro blurbs for May webinar

Thanks Rachel — happy to help. Preference is the earlier guest slot (10:05 PT).

Blurb: "Sana Ahmed is Head of ML Partnerships at Acme Analytics, focusing on productionizing models for enterprise workflows."

I'll also drop a headshot into this thread by EOD tomorrow.

— Sana
---
From: Jorge Morales <jorge@edgeai.co>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, Apr 30 2027 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Finalizing guest slots + 2-line intro blurbs for May webinar

Appreciate the invite. I should be fine in either slot but prefer the later one (10:40 PT) to avoid a conflicting customer briefing.

Blurb: "Jorge Morales leads inference engineering at EdgeAI, building low-latency serving pipelines for time-sensitive applications."

Attaching a short bio PDF and my headshot. Let me know if you need different crop or file type.

— Jorge
Attachment: jorge_bio.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: jorge_headshot.png (image/png)
---
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Sana Ahmed <sana@acmeanalytics.com>, Jorge Morales <jorge@edgeai.co>
Date: Mon, May 02 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalizing guest slots + 2-line intro blurbs for May webinar

Thanks all — I've penciled Sana for 10:05–10:20 PT and Jorge for 10:40–10:55 PT. Calendar invites incoming. Quick operational notes:
- Please confirm slides are uploaded to the shared Drive folder by May 8. Use the attached slide-template.pptx.
- We will run a tech check on May 10 at 09:30 PT (30 mins).
- Laura will moderate and will ask each guest for a 60–90 second opening; we will reserve 10 minutes at the end for audience Q&A.

Rachel — can you confirm if we should include a single consolidated speaker intro slide before the discussion?

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sana Ahmed <sana@acmeanalytics.com>, Jorge Morales <jorge@edgeai.co>
Date: Mon, May 02 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalizing guest slots + 2-line intro blurbs for May webinar

Confirmed — please see calendar events I just created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456

We will have a consolidated speaker intro slide (title + 2-line blurb + headshot for each guest) at 10:03 PT. Laura — I'll share editable copies of the intro and bios in the Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/RI-webinar-brief.

Attachments: RI_webinar_speakerbrief_v3.pdf, slide-template.pptx

Looking forward — if any of you need a different time for the tech check, shout and we'll adjust.

Best,
Rachel
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel@redwood.ai
